description: submission.rs:635: process_create returns Result<Value, Value> using serde_json::Value as both success and error. Using the same type for Ok and Err loses the ability to distinguish at the type level, forces callers to match on both arms as if they were the same, and makes the signature unreadable ('what does Err(Value) mean?'). The error case is always a JMAP SetError or a json\! error object. A proper approach: fn process_create(...) -> Result<Value, SetCreationError> where SetCreationError is an enum with SetError(SetError) and Other(String) variants, then convert to Value at the call site. This gives the compiler a chance to catch misuse.
title: process_create in submission.rs returns Result<Value, Value>: non-idiomatic error type
